messages:
emma: Hey folks — all-hands in ~12m. Quick updates: 1) need to swap agenda order (roadmap before Q&A) 2) recorder VM dropped last recording, can someone stand by to swap encoder 3) leadership will do a short Q&A at the end. Will post final agenda in 5.

sre-bot: Recorder VM (recorder-03) failure detected 3m ago — disk io error :rotating_light:. Auto-restart attempted.

mike: I can jump on the recorder swap. Which machine to cutover to? @sre-bot can you confirm that recorder-02 is clean?

sre-bot: recorder-02 found healthy. No current recording locks. Manual failover steps: `ssh recorder-02 && sudo systemctl start obs-record` — confirm when you take over.

laura: Roadmap swap is fine — prefer moving the infra roadmap to 2nd slot so infra folks can leave early. OK if I condense slides to 8m?

emma: Yes please — condense infra to 8m. @alex you're on leadership opening; can you open with 3 slides instead of 5?

alex: Yep, I'll cut to 3. Also will be online 5m early to check mics.

san: Heads up — OBS on recorder-03 is stuck in `Saving data` state. Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-23 14:02:11] obs: stream: write error: Input/output error
[2026-03-23 14:02:12] obs: aborting segment write
```
I recommend switching to recorder-02 and starting a rolling backup of last 20m of VM disk before we kill recorder-03.

mike: Got it. I'll run the backup now and then start recorder-02. Will post when ready.

jen_ops: If we do the swap please ping #video-ops so the captioning team can reconnect. Also captions need a 10s warmup window.

mike: Backup started: `dd if=/dev/sda of=/mnt/backup/recorder-03-bs.img bs=4M status=progress` — ETA ~3m.

laura: Also can we move the AMA to the end and ask folks to post follow-up Qs in the #all-hands-questions thread? I'll triage live.

emma: Sounds good. Final note: recording will be marked as 'partial' if we failover — please make sure clips are saved. I'll update the agenda message in 2m. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick swaps. See you on the stream in 10.

mike: Recorder-02 live. `sudo systemctl status obs-record` shows active (running). Starting live test clip now.

san: Test clip received, captioning reconnect successful. All-hands stream green.

emma: Perfect — moving doors open to ✅. Thanks for the quick response team, we'll catch up on action items after the meeting.
